models.elections: Elections are voting events where members choose leaders for positions like President, Treasurer, or Secretary. Each election has a nomination period followed by a voting period.
models.positions: Positions are leadership roles within an association that can be filled through elections. They have term limits and responsibilities.
models.candidates: Candidates are members who are running for a position in an election. They have campaign profiles with platform statements and endorsements.
models.proposals: Proposals are motions submitted by members for the community to vote on. They go through discussion, voting, and implementation phases.
models.proposalComments: Comments on proposals allow members to discuss, ask questions, and suggest amendments before voting.
models.committees: Committees are sub-groups within an association focused on specific responsibilities like finance, events, or membership.
models.committeeMembers: Committee members are assigned to committees with roles like Chair, Vice-Chair, or regular Member.
models.votes: Votes are individual ballots cast by members on elections or proposals. They may be secret or open depending on governance settings.
models.endorsements: Endorsements are public support statements from members for candidates running in elections.
models.decisions: Decisions are archived records of completed elections and proposals, preserving the outcome and vote counts for historical reference.
models.governanceSettings: Governance settings configure voting rules, quorum requirements, and cultural preferences for each association.

relationships: Each Election belongs to an Association and contains one or more Positions to fill
Candidates run for Positions within Elections and can receive Endorsements from other members
Proposals belong to an Association and can have multiple Comments for discussion
Votes are cast on either Elections (for Candidates) or Proposals (for/against)
Committees belong to Associations and have CommitteeMembers with different roles
Completed Elections and Proposals become archived Decisions
GovernanceSettings configure the rules for an Association's democratic processes

candidates.name: Maria Santos
candidates.platformStatement: As your current President, I've led our association through significant growth, adding three new circles and increasing our emergency fund reserves by 40%. I'm seeking re-election to complete our digital transformation initiative and expand our youth membership program.

candidates.name: Robert Kim
candidates.platformStatement: I believe our association needs fresh leadership to address the challenges facing our younger members. My priorities include modernizing our communication channels, creating flexible contribution options, and building stronger partnerships with local businesses.

candidates.name: James Chen
candidates.platformStatement: My tenure as Treasurer has seen our association achieve 100% on-time payouts and zero financial discrepancies. I want to continue this track record while implementing new investment strategies for our idle funds.

candidates.name: Linda Okonkwo
candidates.platformStatement: With 20 years of corporate finance experience, I bring institutional-grade financial management to our community organization. I'll focus on transparency, regular financial education workshops, and exploring credit-building partnerships.

candidates.name: Sophie Martin
candidates.platformStatement: As a professional administrator and long-time member, I'll bring organizational excellence to the Secretary role. My focus will be on digitizing our records, improving meeting efficiency, and ensuring all members stay informed.

candidates.name: Michael Torres
candidates.platformStatement: Communication is key to our community's success. As Secretary, I'll establish a monthly newsletter, improve our social media presence, and create a member portal for easy access to all association documents and updates.

candidates.name: Fatima Al-Hassan
candidates.platformStatement: Growing our community is my passion. I've already recruited 8 new members through my personal network and have plans to partner with local community centers to reach underserved populations who could benefit from our savings circles.

candidates.name: Emmanuel Diallo
candidates.platformStatement: I want to focus on engaging our younger members and second-generation diaspora. My plan includes a mentorship program pairing new members with experienced savers and hosting financial literacy workshops for young professionals.

endorsements.statement: Maria has been an exceptional leader who brings our community together. Her vision and dedication have made our association stronger.
I've worked closely with Maria as Vice President and can attest to her commitment, fairness, and tireless work ethic.
James has maintained our finances with impeccable accuracy. His expertise gives our members confidence in our financial operations.
Robert represents the next generation of leadership. His fresh ideas and energy will help us grow and adapt.
Linda's financial expertise is exactly what we need. Her corporate background will professionalize our treasury operations.

proposals.title: Increase Emergency Fund Contribution Rate
proposals.description: Proposal to increase the emergency fund contribution rate from 1% to 1.5% of all circle contributions to build a stronger safety net for members facing financial hardship.

proposals.title: Create Youth Savings Circle Program
proposals.description: Establish a dedicated savings circle program for members aged 18-25 with reduced contribution amounts ($50/month) and financial literacy workshops included.

proposals.title: Adopt Ranked-Choice Voting for Elections
proposals.description: Change our election voting method from simple majority to ranked-choice voting to better represent member preferences and reduce the need for runoff elections.

proposals.title: Annual Membership Dues Increase
proposals.description: Increase annual membership dues from $50 to $75 to cover rising operational costs and fund new member services.

proposals.title: Partner with Local Credit Union
proposals.description: Establish a formal partnership with Unity Credit Union to provide members with preferential rates on savings accounts and small loans based on their CircleUp participation history.

proposalComments.content: I support this proposal. The 0.5% increase is reasonable and will significantly strengthen our emergency fund over time.
While I understand the need, I'm concerned about the impact on members with tight budgets. Could we consider a tiered approach based on contribution amount?
Thank you for the feedback, Charles. The increase amounts to only $2.50 extra per month for a $500 contribution. However, I'm open to discussing a cap for lower-income members.
This is exactly the kind of initiative we need to attract younger members. I'd suggest also including a mentorship component pairing youth with experienced savers.
Amendment proposal: Include a 3-month trial period before full program launch to test the concept with a pilot group of 10 participants.
